harder-to-monitor end CLAIMS By Mark Rosanes 26 Oct 2026 Share A 24-year-old man was arrested in Devon last month after an insurer referred a third suspicious claim, worth £64,800, to police before it could be settled. Two earlier claims under the same policy had already paid out £28,220 for over 650 sheep he alleged were stolen. The case illustrates what early claims vigilance can achieve in a corner of the market where fraud is rarely discussed but quietly growing.
